1	"""Config loader with layered overrides."""
2	from __future__ import annotations
3	
4	import json
5	import os
6	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
7	from pathlib import Path
8	
9	
10	@dataclass
11	class Layer:
12	    name: str
13	    values: dict[str, object] = field(default_factory=dict)
14	
15	
16	def from_env(source: str) -> Layer:
17	    """Build a layer from the env source."""
18	    values: dict[str, object] = {}
19	    for key, raw in _items(source):
20	        if key.startswith('_'):
21	            continue
22	        values[key.lower()] = _coerce(raw)
23	    return Layer(name='env', values=values)
24	
25	
26	def from_file(source: str) -> Layer:

154	
155	
156	class Loader:
157	    def __init__(self, layers: list[Layer]) -> None:
158	        self.layers = layers
159	
160	    async def refresh(self) -> None:
161	        for layer in self.layers:
162	            layer.values.update(await _fetch(layer.name))
163	
164	    def get(self, key: str, default: object = None) -> object:
165	        for layer in reversed(self.layers):
166	            if key in layer.values:
167	                return layer.values[key]
168	        return default
169	
170	    def section_0(self) -> dict[str, object]:
171	        return {k: v for k, v in self.layers[-1].values.items() if k.startswith('s0.')}
172	
173	    def section_1(self) -> dict[str, object]:
174	        return {k: v for k, v in self.layers[-1].values.items() if k.startswith('s1.')}
